Hi everyone,
Please find the Milestone 3 submission at the following link. Please note that the link will direct you to a Notion page containing the Proof of Achievement report for Milestone 3.

For ease of review, you can access the six published case studies directly below:
1️⃣ DeltaDeFi – https://leanpub.com/deltadefi
2️⃣ ClarityDAO – https://leanpub.com/claritydao
3️⃣ Andamio – https://leanpub.com/andamio
4️⃣ Atrium – https://leanpub.com/off-chainimpact-Atrium
5️⃣ DigiFarm – https://leanpub.com/off-chainimpact-DigiFarmAi
6️⃣ TapTools – https://leanpub.com/off-chainimpact-Taptools

Additionally, the related social media announcement can be viewed here:
https://x.com/STORM_Partners/status/2032132449484841289

Note for Catalyst Reviewers:
It was indicated that the case studies appear to be behind a paywall. We want to clarify that this is not the case. The platform (Leanpub) allows users to access the content for $0 by simply entering an email address.
While a minimum suggested price (e.g., $1) may be displayed by default, users can manually input $0 to access the content at no cost. Unfortunately, this default setting cannot be removed on our end.
We understand this may cause confusion and appreciate your understanding.

Please let us know if there are any other questions. We are happy to support.
Kind regards, 
STORM Partners Team.
